ambient: The walls are where the walls are.
A very long time goes by and isn't long.
description: The last one. It's the size of the thing that's left of you and it fits exactly and it isn't uncomfortable. There's nothing in here that needs doing. Everything that was going to be decided has been.
name: The Smallest Room

looks: It fits. That's the whole of what can be said about it.
No door, and no wall you could point to as the one without a door in it.
It's the size it needs to be, which is smaller than it was.
objects.name: the room

looks: Enough to be counted as one.
It isn't frightened. It hasn't been given anything to be frightened with.
It would answer to your name out of habit.
objects.name: what's left

weather: Even. Exactly the temperature of a body, which removes the question.
